persona: English is her second language; short, simple sentences. Cooperative. Took only one photo, at night, and it is blurry.
initial_message: Hi, I want to make claim. Saturday 19 September in the evening the water pipe from dishwasher come off and water go under my kitchen floor. Now the floor is swelling and lifting in kitchen and dining. I turn off the tap under the sink. Nobody hurt.

facts.policyholder.name: Anjali Nikauridge
facts.incident.description: On Saturday evening the water supply hose came off the back of the dishwasher. Water spread under the laminate floor in the kitchen and dining area before I noticed. I turned off the tap under the sink and dried what I could.
facts.incident.cause: The dishwasher water supply hose came loose
facts.loss.description: Laminate floor swollen and lifted at the joins over about 14 m2 of the kitchen and dining area
facts.mitigation.emergency_action: Turned off the tap under the sink, pulled the dishwasher out and dried the floor with towels
facts.evidence.photos: One photo taken on Saturday night with my phone. The light was bad and it is very blurry. I have no other photo.
facts.if_asked_for_a_clearer_photo: Yes, I can take a clearer photo in daylight tomorrow and send it then.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Kauri Dean Builders, total $4,232.00 including GST, dated 23 September 2026. Available now.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo at night in a kitchen lit by a single downlight: light oak-look laminate flooring swollen and peaked along its joins in front of the lower kitchen cabinets, with a shallow puddle of water on the floor and a towel pushed against the cabinet kickboard. The frame shows the floor and the bottom of the cabinets only.

design.notes: Boundary: the only photo of the damage is blurred beyond reading; no clear photo remains.

triage.rationale: The only photo of the floor is too blurred to show the damage, so a usable incident image is still needed. The quote is complete (NZD 4,232.00 including GST), the leak is stopped and the home is habitable. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2020-02-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.
